title: Astrid and the Machine
author: Lior Vasquez
blurb: Wren Pemberton, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
